text: @goodandready/dsh-web-gateway 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的网页搜索与页面提取插件。它向 DSH 注册独立的 web_gateway 工具，并在内置网页工具受限或结果为空时提供可配置的 provider 回退链。功能包括按多种来源搜索网页、提取页面 Markdown，以及组合搜索结果和页面内容生成多来源研究摘要。适合需要联网查找资料、读取网页或整理多个来源的 DSH 用户。搜索可先尝试免密来源，也可配置 Tavily、Brave、Firecrawl、Exa 等凭据；部分查询和 URL 会发送给所选外部服务。

@goodandready/dsh-web-gateway adds DSH tools for web search, Markdown extraction, and multi-source research briefs. Configurable provider fallbacks help when built-in tools are limited. Keyless sources run first; credentials enable keyed services. Queries and URLs may be sent to providers.
DSH 自带的网页搜索经常限流时，能不能换其他来源继续查？
帮我搜索网页并把几个来源的内容整理成简短研究摘要。
I need a fallback that can fetch a public web page and return readable Markdown.
@goodandready/dsh-web-gateway 的功能「多来源网页搜索」：通过 web_gateway_search 查询网页，可选择回退、竞速或聚合策略，并返回标题、链接、摘要及未采用来源信息。
@goodandready/dsh-web-gateway 的功能「页面提取与研究摘要」：web_gateway_extract 将网页提取为 Markdown；web_gateway_research 搜索主题并汇总多个页面。
@goodandready/dsh-web-gateway 使用前须知：搜索词和提取 URL 会发送给所选云端服务；免密 Firecrawl 也会收到公开 URL。可配置密钥启用 Tavily、Brave、Firecrawl 或 Exa。

@goodandready/dsh-web-gateway README · 📦 @goodandready/dsh-web-gateway：Resilient **web search** and **page extract** tools for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

When the built-in `web_search` / `web_fetch` tools hit rate limits, captchas, or empty results, this plugin gives the model a separate fallback chain with different tool names (no registration collisions).

@goodandready/dsh-web-gateway README · 📦 @goodandready/dsh-web-gateway：Free tiers are tried before keys: Firecrawl keyless, Keenable keyless, local SearXNG, and DuckDuckGo run before any keyed provider. Every result names the exact mode (`firecrawl:free`, `firecrawl:key#2`).

@goodandready/dsh-web-gateway README · Overview / The Problem：DSH ships `web_search` and `web_fetch`, but a single upstream can rate-limit, captcha, or return an empty result. This plugin adds separate `web_gateway_*` tools with an explicit attempt model: each provider expands into free and keyed attempts, every free attempt runs before any keyed attempt, and each skip or failure is reported with its mode.

@goodandready/dsh-web-gateway README · Overview / The Problem：The plugin does not replace the built-in tools and does not register `web_search` / `web_fetch`. It is a fallback surface for the model, with operator-controlled provider order, caps, credentials, and diagnostics.

@goodandready/dsh-web-gateway README · Architecture：```mermaid
graph LR
  A[Agent tool call] --> B[web_gateway_search / extract / research]
  B --> C[Attempt expansion: provider + mode]
  C --> D[Free tier: keyless Firecrawl, Keenable, SearXNG, DuckDuckGo, Jina, readability]

@goodandready/dsh-web-gateway README · Architecture：| Module | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | Host facade: Config, tool registration, health/update route registration |
| `lib/attempts.js` | Expands a provider order into `provider:mode` attempts; free-first ordering |
| `lib/chain.js` | Fallback, race, aggregate; per-attempt timeout and run-wide deadline |
| `lib/guards.js` | Per-mode caps, circuit breaker and telemetry around each attempt |
| `lib/providers.js` | Provider HTTP calls, bounded JSON reads, screenshots, document formatting |
| `lib/url-policy.js` | URL parsing, public-IP/DNS policy, connect-time safe `undici` dispatcher |
| `lib/updater.js` | Same-origin update status/apply routes; exact-version install |
| `lib/client.js` | Settings card, health/updater blocks, `en`/`zh` locales and styles |

@goodandready/dsh-web-gateway README · Tools：| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `web_gateway_search` | Search the web. Free tier: **Firecrawl keyless → Keenable keyless → SearXNG → DuckDuckGo**; then keys: **Firecrawl → Keenable → Tavily → Brave → Exa** |
| `web_gateway_extract` | Fetch a URL as markdown. Free tier: **Firecrawl keyless → Jina → readability**; then keys: **Firecrawl → Tavily → Crawl4AI** |
| `web_gateway_research` | Search + extract top sources into a capped multi-source brief |

@goodandready/dsh-web-gateway README · HTTP API：The settings card uses two same-origin routes. Loopback requests are always allowed; remote browsers are allowed only when `Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin` or when `Origin` and `Host` match the request host. This lets the card work through a LAN/Tailscale/reverse-proxy DSH UI without opening the routes to cross-site traffic.

@goodandready/dsh-web-gateway README · HTTP API：| Route | Methods | Access | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/api/dsh-web-gateway/health` | `GET`, `HEAD` | loopback or same-origin | Credential presence, local endpoint health, caps, breaker, telemetry |
| `/api/dsh-web-gateway/health` | `POST` | loopback or same-origin | Reset telemetry |
| `/api/dsh-web-gateway/update` | `GET`, `HEAD` | loopback or same-origin | Current/latest version check |
| `/api/dsh-web-gateway/update` | `POST` | loopback or same-origin + `x-dsh-plugin-update: 1` | Install the exact latest version |

@goodandready/dsh-web-gateway README · HTTP API：A provider is skipped on missing key, empty result, HTTP 429/5xx, rate limits or network error. Built-in **Circuit Breaker** temporarily pauses providers suffering consecutive failures to avoid long timeouts. Results are cached in memory (configurable TTL). Successful responses include `provider`, `skipped` (providers not used and why), and `cached`.

@goodandready/dsh-web-gateway README · Free tier first：The plugin expands each provider into free and keyed attempts. With `freeTierFirst` (default), every free attempt runs before every keyed attempt:

1. Firecrawl keyless
2. Keenable keyless
3. SearXNG (if configured)
4. DuckDuckGo
5. Firecrawl key
6. Keenable key
7. Tavily
8. Brave
9. Exa

`freeTierFirst=false` interleaves free and keyed attempts per provider. To disable keyless entirely, set `firecrawlKeylessSearch=false`, `firecrawlKeylessFetch=false`, and `keenableEnabled=false`.

@goodandready/dsh-web-gateway README · Free tier first：Keenable joins the default order on upgrade; set `keenableEnabled=false` to opt out.

A provider with a comma-separated credential value uses its keys in order. Authentication, rate-limit, and quota failures rotate to the next key.

@goodandready/dsh-web-gateway README · Free tier first：Extract URLs are validated: **http/https only**, no embedded credentials, and hostnames must resolve to **public** IPs (loopback / RFC1918 / link-local / metadata blocked). The public-IP check is repeated at connect time by the `undici` dispatcher. Set `allowInternalUrls` only if you intentionally need internal targets; even then cloud providers are skipped and only local `readability` runs.

@goodandready/dsh-web-gateway README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @goodandready/dsh-web-gateway
```

Restart the web profile after install.

@goodandready/dsh-web-gateway README · Credentials：Add keys under **Settings → Credentials** (or `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`). The settings card stores only **credential names**, never secret values:

@goodandready/dsh-web-gateway README · Credentials：| Default name | Used by |
|---|---|
| `TAVILY_API_KEY` | search + extract (keyed tier) |
| `FIRECRAWL_API_KEY` | optional: keyless search/scrape works without it; a key adds its own quota |
| `KEENABLE_API_KEY` | optional: keyless search works without it; a key lifts the hourly cap |
| `EXA_API_KEY` | search |
| `BRAVE_API_KEY` | search |
| `CRAWL4AI_TOKEN` | extract (only if `crawl4aiUrl` is set) |

A credential value may contain multiple keys separated by commas; they are tried in order.

@goodandready/dsh-web-gateway README · Settings：| Setting | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `defaultLimit` | `5` | Default search result count |
| `maxLimit` | `20` | Hard search cap |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-attempt timeout; `searchDeadlineMs` / `extractDeadlineMs` bound the whole chain |
| `cacheTtlMs` | `600000` | In-memory cache TTL (`0` disables) |
| `searxngUrl` | empty | Local SearXNG base URL; empty disables |
| `crawl4aiUrl` | empty | Crawl4AI base URL; empty disables |
| `includeDomains` / `excludeDomains` | empty | Search domain allow/deny lists |
| `freshness` | `any` | `any` / `day` / `week` / `month` |
| `diskCacheEnabled` | `true` | Persist cache under the DSH profile |
| `freeTierFirst` | `true` | All keyless attempts before any keyed attempt |
| `firecrawlKeylessSearch` | `true` | Allow keyless Firecrawl search |
| `firecrawlKeylessFetch` | `true` | Allow keyless Firecrawl extract; sends public URLs to Firecrawl cloud |
| `keenableEnabled` | `true` | Enable Keenable search (keyless, plus keyed when a key exists) |
| `keenableApiKeyEnv` | `KEENABLE_API_KEY` | Keenable credential name |
| `duckduckgoEnabled` | `true` | Enable keyless DuckDuckGo HTML search

@goodandready/dsh-web-gateway README · Limitations：- Local `readability` rejects PDF and DOCX with an explicit reason; Jina or Firecrawl are the document parsers. Do not expect local binary-document conversion.
- Keyless Firecrawl and Keenable receive public queries/URLs without an API key. Disable them if that egress is not acceptable.
- The settings card and its routes are same-origin; a reverse proxy must preserve `Origin` / `Host` (or `Sec-Fetch-Site`) for remote browsers.
- Screenshots are optional, requested only with `take_screenshot`, and capped at 5 MB per file.
- A provider timeout counts as a failure for the circuit breaker; repeated timeouts eventually pause that provider.

@goodandready/dsh-web-gateway README · How it relates to core DSH web tools：DeepSeek Harness already ships `web_search` and `web_fetch` via `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web`. This plugin does **not** replace them. It registers `web_gateway_*` tools so the model can fall back when the built-in path fails.
